findings.title: Re-application rolls back SECURITY DEFINER search_path hardening (fingerprint drift)
findings.evidence: Fingerprints differ (after_first=465cafc48d2bb664e8c2be9fd562247d96659e42631a49380ff9701a9f63417b vs after_repeat=f19b4fddfef00f96b322a13e4e8deda0b0722e33fa55f00953a18af35861f7b6); changed sections: functions, function_acl, policies, grants. 7 SECURITY DEFINER functions revert to unpinned/loose search_path.
findings.remediation: Make the non-idempotent migrations idempotent (DROP POLICY IF EXISTS) so their `SET search_path` hardening survives re-application; then re-verify the fingerprint is stable.

findings.title: No committed Supabase-generated TypeScript types; client is untyped
findings.evidence: src/infrastructure/supabase/client.ts builds `createClient(...)` without a `Database` generic; repository results are read as `any`; no `.returns<T>()`/`.cast<T>()` anywhere in src/; no `Database` type is committed.
findings.remediation: Generate `supabase gen types` against the canonical verified schema (NOT a possibly drifted hosted DB), commit it, thread the `Database` generic through the client, and add typed DTO/mapper + runtime contract tests for non-table (jsonb/record) RPC return shapes, which generated types cannot fully guarantee.

findings.title: Sensitive payroll tables writable by any center member (no governed role)
findings.evidence: attendance_records (policy "attendance_tenant" FOR ALL USING app_private.is_center_member(center_id)); employee_advances (policy "advances_tenant" FOR ALL USING app_private.is_center_member(center_id)); payroll_line_items (policy "payroll_lines_tenant" FOR ALL USING app_private.is_center_member(center_id)); payroll_runs (policy "payroll_runs_tenant" FOR ALL USING app_private.is_center_member(center_id))
findings.remediation: Split into per-operation policies and gate payroll writes (attendance_records, employee_advances, payroll_runs, payroll_line_items) on a governed role check (user_metadata.role IN ADMIN/MANAGER), not center membership alone.

findings.title: Frontend-referenced RPCs with no client-role EXECUTE grant
findings.evidence: public_cancel_booking_v1, public_center_info_v1, public_client_portal_login_v1, public_client_portal_profile_v2, public_create_booking_v1, public_list_services_v1, public_list_staff_v1, public_reschedule_booking_v1, public_taken_slots_v1 have EXECUTE only for the owner (postgres); no anon/authenticated grant. The security-grant-repair migration deliberately left the public booking/portal RPCs un-granted; the frontend still references them.
findings.remediation: For each: grant EXECUTE to the intended client role (if the feature should be live) OR mark the frontend call as not-yet-enabled and remove it from the live surface.

findings.title: Non-idempotent migration: 20260628000012_customer_experience_forecasting_accounting_advanced.sql
findings.remediation: Prepend `DROP POLICY IF EXISTS <name> ON <table>;` before the CREATE POLICY so the migration can be re-applied cleanly.

findings.title: Non-idempotent migration: 20260810000005_security_hardening_auth.sql
findings.remediation: Prepend `DROP POLICY IF EXISTS <name> ON <table>;` before the CREATE POLICY so the migration can be re-applied cleanly.

findings.title: Foreign key marked NOT VALID: payments.payments_invoice_center_fk
findings.evidence: FOREIGN KEY (invoice_id, center_id) REFERENCES invoices(id, center_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT NOT VALID
findings.remediation: Query for orphaned/cross-center rows, then `ALTER TABLE ... VALIDATE CONSTRAINT ...` to extend protection to existing rows.

findings.title: Foreign key marked NOT VALID: services.services_category_fk
findings.evidence: FOREIGN KEY (category_id) REFERENCES service_categories(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT NOT VALID
findings.remediation: Query for orphaned/cross-center rows, then `ALTER TABLE ... VALIDATE CONSTRAINT ...` to extend protection to existing rows.

findings.title: Overlapping foreign keys on the same target: payments -> invoices
findings.evidence: Two FKs reference the same target: FOREIGN KEY (invoice_id, center_id) REFERENCES invoices(id, center_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT NOT VALID AND FOREIGN KEY (invoice_id) REFERENCES invoices(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT. The composite (invoice_id, center_id) FK enforces tenant integrity and is NOT redundant.
findings.remediation: 1) Query orphaned/cross-center payment rows; 2) validate payments_invoice_center_fk; 3) inspect PostgREST relationship behaviour and every frontend embed; 4) only then decide whether the simple invoice_id FK can be removed. Do not remove either FK until API relationship behaviour is verified.

findings.title: Internal app_private routines retain PUBLIC EXECUTE: app_private.maintain_entitlement_balance_v1
findings.evidence: These app_private routines keep the default PostgreSQL PUBLIC EXECUTE grant (created after the least-privilege repair).
findings.remediation: REVOKE EXECUTE ... FROM PUBLIC on internal routines; ensure default privileges suppress PUBLIC for the creating role.

findings.title: Scanner limitation (manual review): dynamic-from
findings.remediation: Manually confirm this construct against the canonical schema.

findings.title: btree_gist exclusion constraint is canonical-only (replay surrogate)
findings.evidence: appointments_no_scheduled_staff_overlap EXCLUDE requires btree_gist gist `=` opclass, unavailable in PGlite.
findings.remediation: No code change; the constraint exists in the canonical migration and applies in Supabase.

findings.title: RPC return shapes (jsonb/record) are untyped at rest
findings.evidence: Several RPCs return jsonb or record (e.g. process_checkout_v1, public_*_v1) and the frontend reads specific fields; generated types cannot fully guarantee these shapes.
findings.remediation: Add typed DTO/mapper + runtime contract tests for non-table RPC results.
